annotations.text:
Brief: "I want to know which intervals occur in a chord of my choice."

The old tool answered it with a 12-button grid where 6 buttons were greyed out — you had to read ABSENCE to get the answer. Here the list IS the answer: one row per interval that actually exists, nothing to decode.

The neck moved out of the always-on layout and into an opened row — and shows ONE placement at a time with a stepper, instead of 11 crossing lines at once.

+8va became a plain-language chip inside that row: "Octave wider — Major 10th".
